project.name: netsec.github.io
project.description: Official website and open community directory of COST Action CA24154, Networking European Security Knowledge (NetSec): a dependency-light static GitHub Pages site with hand-authored HTML pages in English, French and German, shared CSS and JavaScript, and a Python scripts/ layer that syncs and validates data through GitHub Actions workflows.

nodes.name: _analytics.py
nodes.summary: Single home for the cookieless GoatCounter visitor-counter script tag, shared by the two page generators so the account code is set once; returns nothing while no account is configured.

nodes.name: build-profile-pages.py
nodes.summary: Generator that server-renders a shareable per-member profile page at /people/<slug>.html in EN, FR and DE from data/bios.json, reusing the locale directory shell's chrome and adding Open Graph metadata and Person JSON-LD.
nodes.languageNotes: Builds HTML by string templating with html.escape rather than a template engine, and splices the nav, footer and head assets verbatim from people.*.html so the generated chrome cannot drift from the hand-authored shell.

nodes.name: check-i18n-drift.py
nodes.summary: CI translation-drift checker that compares SHA-1 hashes of each English page against the hash recorded in data/i18n-state.json when its FR/DE translation was made, normalising out generated regions before hashing; --mark-fresh blesses a manually refreshed translation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses regex normalisation (cache-bust queries, facepiles, map list region, cost.eu stat digits, analytics tag) before hashing so data-driven markup changes do not raise false drift.

nodes.name: inject-seo.py
nodes.summary: Idempotent build step that injects canonical, Open Graph, Twitter Card and JSON-LD blocks (Organization, WebSite, FAQPage, DefinedTermSet, Event) into managed pages between sentinel comments, and stamps every local CSS/JS reference with a content-hash ?v= cache-bust token; --check reports drift for CI.
nodes.languageNotes: Schema.org JSON-LD nodes are derived from the pages' own visible FAQ and glossary markup, and event times are rendered with zoneinfo offsets.

nodes.name: test-analytics.py
nodes.summary: pytest suite pinning the visitor-counter behaviour: the committed site code is set, clearing it emits nothing, and both inject-seo.py and build-profile-pages.py stamp the tag (including the 404 path reporter) only while the counter is on.
nodes.languageNotes: Loads hyphenated script filenames as modules with importlib.util.spec_from_file_location and uses monkeypatch fixtures to toggle the module-level SITE_CODE.

nodes.name: tag
nodes.summary: Returns the async GoatCounter script tag for the configured account, or an empty string when SITE_CODE is unset.

nodes.name: lines
nodes.summary: Returns the counter tag as a list of head lines with an explanatory comment, optionally prefixed by the 404 path-reporting snippet, so generators can extend their line lists unconditionally.

nodes.name: scaffold_body
nodes.summary: Assembles the prefilled, localised intro message body for contacting a member about a given intent.

nodes.name: similar_members
nodes.summary: Ranks other members by shared canonical keywords, then shared themes, then name, to find people working on related topics.

nodes.name: career_stage
nodes.summary: Infers a hidden seniority signal from the academic position or name honorific, mirroring careerStage() in people-directory.js, to order mentor suggestions.

nodes.name: mentors_on_topics
nodes.summary: Selects members offering mentorship who share a topic with the target, ranked by keyword overlap, theme overlap and seniority.

nodes.name: render_areas
nodes.summary: Renders research-theme and region chips that deep-link to the directory pre-filtered on that facet.

nodes.name: render_similar
nodes.summary: Renders a facepile of related members linking to their profile pages, plus a link to the filtered directory.

nodes.name: render_mentors
nodes.summary: Renders a facepile of mentors on the target's topics using the similar-people styling.

nodes.name: extract_chrome
nodes.summary: Extracts the head asset block, nav header, footer and site.js tag from a people.*.html shell for verbatim reuse on profile pages.

nodes.name: render_contacts
nodes.summary: Renders the contact-icon row (email, ORCID, social links) with the same SVG glyphs the directory uses.

nodes.name: render_actions
nodes.summary: Renders the founding badge and the mentorship and STSM-hosting calls to action, as mailto buttons when an email is published.

nodes.name: render_prize
nodes.summary: Renders a gold prize pill for members holding a NetSec prize, shown only on the full profile page.

nodes.name: render_pubs
nodes.summary: Renders the member's publication list from ORCID works.

nodes.name: render_card
nodes.summary: Builds the full static profile card: hero band with photo, identity and actions over a bio and publications column and a sidebar of themes, similar people, mentors and contacts.

nodes.name: person_jsonld
nodes.summary: Builds the schema.org Person JSON-LD record for a member's canonical profile URL.

nodes.name: build_page
nodes.summary: Assembles one complete localised profile HTML page with head metadata, Open Graph tags, JSON-LD, analytics tag and the reused site chrome.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Loads bios, ORCID works and prizes, then builds every member's page in all three locales.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point that writes the generated profile pages under people/ and reports the result.

nodes.name: sha1
nodes.summary: Computes the SHA-1 of a page after normalising out cache-bust queries, the analytics tag, facepiles, the map list region and cost.eu stat digits.

nodes.name: report
nodes.summary: Prints a translation status table and returns 0 when fresh, 1 when drifted, 2 when a translated file is missing.

nodes.name: mark_fresh
nodes.summary: Records the current source hash and date for a refreshed translation in data/i18n-state.json.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point dispatching between the drift report and --mark-fresh.

nodes.name: probe
nodes.summary: Extracts the language, title and meta description from a page's HTML.

nodes.name: _plain_text
nodes.summary: Strips tags, unescapes entities and collapses whitespace to produce single-line text for JSON-LD answers and definitions.

nodes.name: _definition_fragment
nodes.summary: Isolates the definition paragraph from a glossary <dd>, excluding member links, sources and facepiles.

nodes.name: build_seo_block
nodes.summary: Builds the managed head block with canonical link, Open Graph, Twitter Card, theme colour, author and the analytics tag.

nodes.name: build_faqpage_node
nodes.summary: Builds a schema.org FAQPage node from the page's existing FAQ markup.

nodes.name: build_definedtermset_node
nodes.summary: Builds a schema.org DefinedTermSet node from the glossary's dt/dd markup.

nodes.name: _event_location
nodes.summary: Builds a schema.org Place or VirtualLocation for an event from its card location data.

nodes.name: build_event_node
nodes.summary: Builds a schema.org Event node for an entry in data/events.json, with timezone-aware start and end times.

nodes.name: build_jsonld_block
nodes.summary: Assembles the JSON-LD script with Organization on every page, WebSite on the home page, and FAQPage, DefinedTermSet or Event nodes where relevant.

nodes.name: inject
nodes.summary: Rewrites or inserts the sentinel-delimited SEO and JSON-LD blocks in a page and returns the new HTML and a changed flag.

nodes.name: compute_asset_versions
nodes.summary: Maps each versionable CSS/JS asset to the first eight hex characters of its SHA-256 content hash.

nodes.name: stamp_assets
nodes.summary: Rewrites local asset references in a page to carry the current ?v=<hash> token, idempotently.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point walking every HTML page to inject SEO blocks, stamp assets and write event dates, or report drift under --check.

nodes.name: test_the_managed_head_block_carries_the_tag_when_the_counter_is_on
nodes.summary: Checks that inject-seo.py's managed head block contains the counter tag inside its sentinels when the counter is on.

nodes.name: sync-bios.py
nodes.summary: Main member-directory sync: fetches the bios Google Form responses as CSV, normalises names, keywords, affiliations, ORCID and social links, downloads and encodes headshots, merges with the prior data/bios.json and writes a deterministic result plus an auto-PR title and overview.
nodes.languageNotes: Writes only on substantive change so idempotent workflow runs leave the working tree clean and the auto-PR step stays quiet.

nodes.name: country_key
nodes.summary: Normalises a country string for case-insensitive comparison when matching members to the MC roster.

nodes.name: parse_timestamp
nodes.summary: Parses a Google Forms timestamp string into epoch seconds so the latest duplicate submission wins.

nodes.name: parse_wgs
nodes.summary: Extracts the set of WG numbers (1 to 4) from a Google Forms checkbox cell.

nodes.name: parse_mentorship
nodes.summary: Maps the mentorship checkbox cell to the directory's mentor and mentee role tags.

nodes.name: parse_stsm_hosting
nodes.summary: Maps the STSM hosting question to a normalised hosting value for the directory.

nodes.name: parse_keywords
nodes.summary: Splits a free-text keyword cell into individual keywords, handling mixed separators.

nodes.name: normalise_title
nodes.summary: Standardises leading honorifics on a member's name to the house style.

nodes.name: build_name
nodes.summary: Assembles a member's display name from the form row's name columns in house style.

nodes.name: load_keyword_aliases
nodes.summary: Loads the keyword vocabulary into an acronym set, an alias-to-canonical map and a spelling map.

nodes.name: load_keyword_themes
nodes.summary: Loads the map from canonical keyword to research theme name from the keyword vocabulary.

nodes.name: load_affiliation_aliases
nodes.summary: Loads the map from affiliation variant spellings to canonical institution names.

nodes.name: load_region_vocab
nodes.summary: Loads the map from lowercased research region names to their canonical display form.

nodes.name: load_keyword_drops
nodes.summary: Returns the lowercased set of keywords configured to be dropped during enrichment.

nodes.name: load_keyword_splits
nodes.summary: Returns the map from a submitted compound keyword to the canonical keywords it splits into.

nodes.name: parse_regions
nodes.summary: Maps a research-regions form cell to canonical region names using the region vocabulary.

nodes.name: normalise_keyword
nodes.summary: Resolves a raw submitted keyword to its canonical display form through punctuation stripping, alias and spelling maps and acronym casing.

nodes.name: normalise_affiliation
nodes.summary: Standardises separator style and aliases inside a free-text affiliation string.

nodes.name: _levenshtein
nodes.summary: Bounded Levenshtein distance used to hint at likely keyword alias candidates during the sync.

nodes.name: flag_alias_candidates
nodes.summary: Prints a reviewer hint when two canonical keywords look like near-duplicates that should be aliased.

nodes.name: normalize_orcid
nodes.summary: Returns the canonical 19-character ORCID iD from any URL or bare form a submitter typed.

nodes.name: normalise_url
nodes.summary: Turns whatever a submitter typed into a clickable absolute URL, or an empty string.

nodes.name: normalise_bluesky
nodes.summary: Converts any of the accepted Bluesky handle forms into a profile URL.

nodes.name: drive_file_id
nodes.summary: Extracts a Google Drive file ID from any common Drive URL form.

nodes.name: download_photo
nodes.summary: Downloads a member headshot, optimises it with Pillow when available, saves it under assets/images/people and returns its path and upstream hash.

nodes.name: ensure_map_avatars
nodes.summary: Writes a map-sized WebP avatar for every headshot so the Network Map can draw small portraits cheaply.

nodes.name: encode_webp
nodes.summary: Encodes an image to WebP downscaled to a maximum width, reporting whether a file was written.

nodes.name: ensure_people_webp
nodes.summary: Ensures every headshot in assets/images/people has a sibling WebP derivative.

nodes.name: resolve_prior_entry
nodes.summary: Finds the prior bios.json entry a form submission collapses onto, using the same email, slug and name-key signals as merge.

nodes.name: strip_bio_chrome
nodes.summary: Drops leading website navigation lines that submitters pasted ahead of their bio text.

nodes.name: row_to_member
nodes.summary: Converts one CSV form row into a bios.json member entry, validating consent and required fields and normalising every column, or returns None to skip it.

nodes.name: load_mc_lookup
nodes.summary: Builds a slug-keyed lookup of Management Committee members with name, country and country code.

nodes.name: apply_mc_role
nodes.summary: Ensures a member who matches the MC list carries the MC role and the roster's country data.

nodes.name: load_founding_slugs
nodes.summary: Returns the set of slugified founding-proposer names used to flag founding contributors.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Merges the prior directory state with the latest form submissions, keyed by email, slug or name key, preserving leadership roles and ordering.

nodes.name: diff_summary
nodes.summary: Produces a human-readable added, updated and removed summary between two member lists.

nodes.name: describe_field_change
nodes.summary: Writes one reviewable line describing how a field changed, not only that it changed.

nodes.name: classify_diff
nodes.summary: Pure categorisation of a sync diff at member level (new, updated, removed) for the auto-PR title and body.

nodes.name: render_pr_title
nodes.summary: Builds a one-line auto-PR title from a classify_diff result.

nodes.name: suggest_theme
nodes.summary: Best-guess research theme for an unthemed keyword based on the existing keyword-to-theme map.

nodes.name: place_unthemed_keywords
nodes.summary: Places each unthemed keyword under the theme suggested by suggest_theme, in place.

nodes.name: render_pr_body_overview
nodes.summary: Renders the Markdown overview block for the auto-PR body ahead of the raw run log, or an empty string when nothing changed.

nodes.name: apply_overrides
nodes.summary: Applies hand corrections from data/bios-overrides.json on top of the synced member entries.

nodes.name: enrich_keywords
nodes.summary: Resolves every member's raw keywords to canonical keywords and themes and writes the derived fields and aggregates.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point that reads the configured sheet URL, fetches and parses the CSV, merges, enriches and writes data/bios.json only on substantive change, and prints the diff.

nodes.name: _emit_pr_summary
nodes.summary: Writes the dynamic PR title and overview to the paths named by workflow environment variables, and is a no-op locally.

nodes.name: dry_run
nodes.summary: Replays the keyword enrichment over the committed bios.json and reports the outcome without writing.

nodes.name: sync-cost.py
nodes.summary: Sync helper that scrapes the cost.eu CA24154 Action page and keeps WG_MAP in the three index pages, per-bio WG memberships, leadership roles, data/wg.json, data/mc-members.json and the MC statistics spans in step with it.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses BeautifulSoup over the live HTML, with per-WG reconciliation state persisted in data/cost-wg-state.json rather than overwriting form-sourced data.

nodes.name: titlecase_name
nodes.summary: Converts cost.eu's uppercase-surname style (e.g. 'Dr Moritz WEISS') to normal title case.

nodes.name: fetch_wg_map
nodes.summary: Parses the cost.eu Membership table into a normalised-name to WG numbers map.

nodes.name: rewrite_wg_map
nodes.summary: Rewrites the WG_MAP literal embedded in every locale's index page and returns the previous map.

nodes.name: report_wg
nodes.summary: Reports the additions and removals between the old and new WG maps.

nodes.name: _load_wg_state
nodes.summary: Loads the per-WG observation clocks from data/cost-wg-state.json.

nodes.name: reconcile_wgs
nodes.summary: Per-WG additive reconciliation between form-sourced WG sets in bios.json and cost.eu's membership, holding and flagging disagreements.

nodes.name: extract_leadership
nodes.summary: Pulls (role, name) pairs from the Leadership and Additional-Roles tables of the cost.eu Action page.

nodes.name: _make_seed_entry
nodes.summary: Creates a skeleton seed bios entry for a leader newly appointed on cost.eu who has no bio yet.

nodes.name: wg_leadership_from_roles
nodes.summary: Derives the lead and co-lead WG leadership object from a member's role list.

nodes.name: apply_leadership
nodes.summary: Mutates data/bios.json so each cost.eu leadership role has exactly one current holder, removing vacated roles with a safety cap.

nodes.name: fetch_members
nodes.summary: Parses cost.eu's Membership table into member records with name, WG and country.

nodes.name: build_wg_json
nodes.summary: Writes data/wg.json with each WG's leadership, full roster and count of members without a bio.

nodes.name: fetch_mc
nodes.summary: Parses cost.eu's Management Committee table into name, country and ISO code records.

nodes.name: apply_mc_roles
nodes.summary: Tags bios.json entries that are official MC members with the MC role.

nodes.name: build_mc_json
nodes.summary: Writes data/mc-members.json from the parsed MC table and reports changes.

nodes.name: apply_stats
nodes.summary: Rewrites the data-cost-stat MC-count and country-count spans across all locales.

nodes.name: check_country_grid
nodes.summary: Drift-checks the hand-authored MC country grid on about.html against the roster without rewriting it.

nodes.name: restamp_index_i18n
nodes.summary: Re-marks index.fr and index.de as i18n-fresh after WG_MAP is rewritten, so the drift checker does not flag a data-only change.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point that fetches the cost.eu page and runs the WG, leadership, wg.json, MC and statistics steps in order, printing a report.

nodes.name: _directory_common.py
nodes.summary: Dependency-free shared name-identity helpers (slugify and name_key) imported by the directory sync and build scripts, so every script keys people identically, including apostrophe surnames.

nodes.name: slugify
nodes.summary: Produces a stable hyphenated slug from a person's name, stripping diacritics, leading honorifics and apostrophes before collapsing non-alphanumerics.

nodes.name: name_key
nodes.summary: Reduces a name to a (first, last) lowercase token pair used to match the same person across data sources despite spelling drift.

nodes.name: build-network-map.py
nodes.summary: Builder that derives data/network-map.json, the node and edge graph behind the Network Map (WG hubs, theme hubs, people, ESSC co-panel and co-authorship edges), and splices an accessible list region into the three locale pages. A --check mode lets CI detect a stale graph.
nodes.languageNotes: Keeps build() a pure function with sorted outputs so the generated JSON is byte-identical across runs, which makes the --check drift gate possible.

nodes.name: _given_first
nodes.summary: Rewrites a surname-first publication author string as 'Given Surname', or returns None when the shape is not recognised.

nodes.name: _resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves a (first, last) key against the person universe, trying an exact match and then an initial-based match.

nodes.name: match_author
nodes.summary: Resolves one publication author string to a person key in the graph, used to derive co-authorship edges.

nodes.name: prefer_webp
nodes.summary: Points a headshot path at the smallest WebP derivative the bios sync has produced, falling back to the original.

nodes.name: normalise_country
nodes.summary: Normalises a country name (lowercase, diacritic-stripped, ampersand spelt out, aliased) for consistent comparison.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Pure function turning wg.json plus optional bios, conference programmes and publications into the network-map graph of WG hubs, theme hubs, deduplicated people and typed edges.

nodes.name: load_programmes
nodes.summary: Merges every conference programme on disk (indico.json and frozen ESSC programme files) into one annualConferences map.

nodes.name: _wg_numbers
nodes.summary: Maps each person id to their sorted WG numbers by reading the bipartite person-to-WG edges of the graph.

nodes.name: render_list_region
nodes.summary: Renders the localised, script-free HTML list alternative to the map canvas for one locale, sentinels included.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point that loads inputs, builds the graph, and either writes network-map.json and the three pages or, with --check, exits non-zero when they are stale.

nodes.name: _pycheck.yml
nodes.summary: Reusable workflow (workflow_call) that checks out the repository, sets up Python 3.12 and runs a single check command, shared by the one-command drift and lint gates so SHA-pinned actions live in one place.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the workflow_call trigger with a string input, so callers invoke it via jobs.<id>.uses with a `command` parameter.

nodes.name: autopr-token-health.yml
nodes.summary: Weekly scheduled probe of the AUTOPR_TOKEN fine-grained PAT used by the auto-PR sync workflows, opening or refreshing an alert issue when the token is missing, rejected or within ten days of expiry.

nodes.name: branch-sweep.yml
nodes.summary: Daily scheduled job that archives and deletes stale unmerged branches with no commits for 14 days, keeping the branch list limited to live work.

nodes.name: brand-lint.yml
nodes.summary: Pull-request gate that runs scripts/check-brand.py through the reusable Python check workflow to enforce brand naming consistency across pages.

nodes.name: calendar-drift.yml
nodes.summary: Pull-request gate that runs scripts/build-calendar.py --check via the reusable Python check workflow, failing when committed calendar outputs are out of step with the event data.

nodes.name: codeql-dependabot-shim.yml
nodes.summary: pull_request_target workflow that posts success statuses for the required CodeQL Analyze contexts on Dependabot PRs, which CodeQL default setup never analyses, so the protect-main ruleset does not block them indefinitely.

nodes.name: css-class-collisions.yml
nodes.summary: Pull-request gate that runs scripts/check-css-class-collisions.py via the reusable Python check workflow to catch CSS class names claimed by distant or conflicting rules.

nodes.name: data-shape-check.yml
nodes.summary: Pull-request gate for synced data and generated artefacts: validates data shapes, smoke-renders consuming pages in headless Chrome, and checks that profile pages, sitemap, directory index, Indico semantics, Network Map and bio search stubs are current.

nodes.name: directory-interactions.yml
nodes.summary: Pull-request smoke test that builds the Pagefind index and drives the Directory page in headless Chrome via puppeteer-core, asserting filter, mentorship wizard and dark-mode interaction contracts.

nodes.name: external-link-arrows.yml
nodes.summary: Pull-request lint that runs scripts/check-external-link-arrows.py via the reusable Python check workflow to ensure external links carry their arrow marker.

nodes.name: failure-alarm.yml
nodes.summary: workflow_run listener on the scheduled sync, deploy and housekeeping workflows that opens or threads a GitHub alarm issue whenever one of them completes with a failure.

nodes.name: i18n-drift.yml
nodes.summary: Pull-request gate that runs scripts/check-i18n-drift.py via the reusable Python check workflow, failing when an English page has changed since its FR or DE translation was last marked fresh.

nodes.name: issue-lifecycle-comment.yml
nodes.summary: Issue-label workflow that posts the standard maintainer message when a lifecycle label (for example needs-info or duplicate) is applied, ignoring labels outside the vocabulary.

nodes.name: issue-sweep.yml
nodes.summary: Daily scheduled job that closes needs-info issues whose reporter has not replied for 60 days, leaving every other open issue untouched as backlog.

nodes.name: launch-qa-link-check.yml
nodes.summary: Link checker run on HTML-touching PRs and weekly on a schedule, resolving every internal and external link with scripts/check-links.sh and checking the accessibility statement's review date.

nodes.name: lighthouse.yml
nodes.summary: Pull-request Lighthouse CI run that serves the static site with scripts/serve-static.cjs and asserts performance and accessibility budgets.

nodes.name: linkedin-version-check.yml
nodes.summary: Monthly scheduled job that runs scripts/check-linkedin-version.py to bump the pinned LinkedIn API version and opens an auto-merging PR when the pin changes.

nodes.name: lock-closed-issues.yml
nodes.summary: Daily scheduled job that silently locks issues closed for 14 or more days with no recent activity, keeping them readable but closed to new comments.

nodes.name: news-drift.yml
nodes.summary: Pull-request gate that runs scripts/build-news-rss.py --check via the reusable Python check workflow, failing when the committed RSS feed lags data/news.json.

nodes.name: pages-deploy.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Pages deployment on push to main and every six hours: renders Open Graph cards and member profile pages, writes home-page fallback event and news cards, builds the Pagefind index, stamps ?v= cache-bust tokens and publishes the working tree.
nodes.languageNotes: The six-hourly schedule is a self-heal: pushes signed by github-actions[bot] from auto-merged PRs do not fire the push trigger.

nodes.name: python-tests.yml
nodes.summary: Runs the scripts/ pytest suites and a pyflakes undefined-names check on pushes and PRs touching scripts, plus the Node home-figures strip counting test.

nodes.name: roadmap-refresh.yml
nodes.summary: Daily scheduled job that refreshes the [Unreleased] autostamp in the roadmap from CHANGELOG.md and the milestone progress data, then opens or updates an auto-merging PR when either surface moves.

nodes.name: search-drift.yml
nodes.summary: Pull-request sanity check that builds the Pagefind index and verifies a valid entry manifest with non-zero indexed page counts for each locale.

nodes.name: seo-asset-check.yml
nodes.summary: Pull-request gate that checks SEO blocks with scripts/inject-seo.py, confirms every top-level page is registered, and verifies editorial photographs have current WebP derivatives.

nodes.name: social-bluesky.yml
nodes.summary: Approval-gated social publishing pipeline: on news.xml changes or manual dispatch it previews posts in dry-run, waits for reviewer approval in the social environment, posts to Bluesky and LinkedIn, then persists the dedup ledger via an auto-merging PR.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a GitHub environment with required reviewers to pause the publish job until a human approves the dry-run preview.

nodes.name: spotlight-rotate.yml
nodes.summary: Weekly scheduled rotation of the member spotlight via scripts/rotate-spotlight.py, rendering the spotlight card, posting it to Bluesky and LinkedIn, and opening an auto-merging PR with the updated spotlight and ledger.

nodes.name: sync-bios.yml
nodes.summary: Daily sync of member bios from the Google Form into data/bios.json, followed by ORCID refresh, flag bundling and regeneration of search stubs, sitemap, directory index, Network Map and field guide, then an auto-PR with a change summary and data-shape verdict.

nodes.name: sync-cost.yml
nodes.summary: Weekly sync of Working Group memberships and leadership from cost.eu, followed by regeneration of bio search stubs, Network Map, directory index and sitemap, then an auto-PR with a change summary and data-shape verdict.

nodes.name: sync-indico.yml
nodes.summary: Daily sync of event programme data from Indico into data/indico.json, rebuilding the Network Map and event structured data, then opening an auto-merging PR when the data changes.

nodes.name: target-size.yml
nodes.summary: Pull-request gate that, when rendered files change, measures every interactive control under a coarse pointer with scripts/measure.mjs and fails on targets below the 44px floor.

nodes.name: bug_report.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub issue form for bug reports against netsec-cost.eu, the directory or the repo tooling, with required preflight checkboxes and fields for the fault, expected behaviour, reproduction steps and environment.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses GitHub's YAML issue-form schema (name, description, title, labels, body) with checkboxes and textarea elements marked required.

nodes.name: config.yml
nodes.summary: Issue-template chooser configuration that disables blank issues and routes routine questions to the public contact form, the FAQ, the Wiki onboarding page and the ESSC 2026 member orientation page.

nodes.name: documentation.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub issue form for documentation problems in the maintainer docs, the Wiki, the PDF documentation pack or the public copy, asking for the affected surface, the exact location, the problem and a proposed correction.

nodes.name: enhancement.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub issue form for feature or structural proposals, enforcing the maintainer's four-section shape (What's happening, Why it matters, Fix path, Target) behind required preflight checkboxes.

nodes.name: 404.html
nodes.summary: Custom GitHub Pages not-found page for the NetSec site, with inline scripts that apply the saved theme, localise its copy into English, French or German, and run an on-page site search to help visitors recover from a broken link.
nodes.languageNotes: Single file serves all three locales: data-i18n attributes are swapped by inline JavaScript rather than shipping separate .fr/.de variants, since GitHub Pages serves only one 404.html.

nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Release history of the NetSec website, opening with the hybrid release-notes format rules (lede, themed sub-sections, index of changes) and an [Unreleased] section, followed by versioned entries up to 1.15.0.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Standing rules for AI-assisted work on the repository: British English and manual translation, the branch-and-squash PR workflow, issue and milestone discipline, release-notes format, prose-voice constraints and lessons learned.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contributor guide routing questions, feature ideas, bug reports, content corrections, translations and code contributions to the right channel, with the code of conduct.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Repository overview of the NetSec COST Action CA24154 website covering layout, local development, the automated sync and pre-merge pipelines, content editing, versioning, security, privacy and licensing.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: Security policy defining scope, how to report a vulnerability, response expectations, safe-harbour terms and the protections maintained on the static site.

nodes.name: about.html

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: The README introduces the official website and open community directory of COST Action CA24154 (NetSec), which also serves as the Action's Deliverable D1. It describes a dependency-light static GitHub Pages site: hand-authored HTML pages load one shared stylesheet and one shared script, and read JSON data files at runtime for the directory, the calendar and the live conference programme. Keep its three ideas in mind for the rest of the tour, which are static pages, JSON data kept fresh by Python syncs, and GitHub Actions as the only build server.

tour.title: The Home Page Entry Point
tour.description: index.html is where both visitors and the dependency graph begin. The page ships complete hand-written HTML for the hero, the Working Groups and the contact section, and small home-*.js scripts then hydrate the event, news, figures and spotlight panels from data/events.json and its siblings. home-events.js shows the pattern used across the site: fetch a JSON file, render cards, and keep the hand-coded HTML in place as a fail-soft fallback if the fetch fails.
tour.languageLesson: Progressive enhancement in plain JavaScript: the HTML is usable on its own, and a script fetches JSON with fetch() and replaces the static fallback only after the data has arrived and parsed. No framework or bundler is involved, so each page simply lists its script tags.

tour.title: Shared CSS and JavaScript
tour.description: site.css and site.js are the two most depended-upon files in the repository, each loaded by roughly 80 pages. The stylesheet defines the theme tokens, the glassmorphism card system, navigation, dark mode and the beta-translation ribbon. The script holds the FR/DE string catalogue behind window.netsecT, the theme toggle, the language switcher, the mobile menu, the guided tour engine and the Pagefind search overlay, so every page from Step 2 onwards inherits the same behaviour without duplicating it.
tour.languageLesson: CSS custom properties (variables declared on :root and redefined under a dark-theme selector) let one stylesheet switch the whole palette at runtime. The JavaScript toggle only flips an attribute on the html element and stores the choice in localStorage.

tour.title: The Directory
tour.description: people.html is the Directory, the open and filterable list of researchers, policy-makers and practitioners that makes up Deliverable D1. Its markup is a shell, and people-directory.js does the work: it loads data/bios.json (the third most referenced file in the graph) and renders member cards with search, keyword, theme, region, Working Group, mentorship and STSM filters, keeping the filter state in the URL hash so a filtered view can be shared as a link.
tour.languageLesson: Storing UI state in location.hash lets a static page support deep links without a server. The renderer reads the hash on load, applies the filters, and writes the hash back whenever a filter changes.

tour.title: Syncing Member Bios
tour.description: data/bios.json from Step 4 is generated rather than edited by hand. sync-bios.py fetches the Google Form responses as CSV, normalises names, keywords, affiliations and ORCID links, downloads headshots and merges the result with the previous file, while bios-overrides.json holds manual corrections that are reapplied after every fetch. The daily sync-bios.yml workflow runs the script, regenerates the derived files and opens an auto-PR, and _directory_common.py supplies the shared slugify and name_key helpers so every script identifies a person in the same way.
tour.languageLesson: A scheduled GitHub Actions workflow uses an on.schedule cron trigger, runs the sync in a job, and only opens a pull request when the generated files differ from what is committed. That makes the sync idempotent: a run with no upstream changes leaves the tree clean.

tour.title: Working Groups from cost.eu
tour.description: A second sync covers the official Action roster. sync-cost.py scrapes the cost.eu CA24154 page and updates Working Group memberships, leadership roles, data/wg.json and the Management Committee figures shown in the home pages. The weekly sync-cost.yml workflow follows the same auto-PR pattern as Step 5, and data/wg.json is cross-referenced with the bios so the Directory and the Working Groups page agree on who belongs where.

tour.title: Events and the Indico Sync
tour.description: Conference data comes from the EISS Indico instance. sync-indico.py fetches category events, decides which are relevant to NetSec, normalises timetables into a day and session programme, writes data/indico.json and patches data/events.json from Step 2. essc-2026.html and essc-programme.js then render that programme in the browser with day chips, a live banner and session cards, and docs/indico-sync.md documents the whole flow, including its privacy posture.

tour.title: Calendar Feeds
tour.description: The event list also feeds people's calendar apps. build-calendar.py reads data/events.json and writes the subscribable calendar.ics feed plus one .ics download per event, with VTIMEZONE blocks so times stay correct across European time zones. Its --check mode powers the calendar-drift.yml gate, which fails a pull request when the committed feeds no longer match the event data.
tour.languageLesson: iCalendar (RFC 5545) is a plain-text format of BEGIN/END blocks. A VTIMEZONE block embeds the time-zone rules inside the file, so a client does not have to guess what a local start time means.

tour.title: The Network Map
tour.description: The Network Map combines the data from Steps 4 to 7 into one picture. build-network-map.py reads the Working Group roster, the bios and the ESSC programme and derives data/network-map.json, a graph of Working Group hubs, theme hubs, people and co-panel edges. It also splices an accessible text list into the three locale pages. On the page itself, network-map.js draws that graph on a canvas with a deterministic force layout, lenses and hover cards, without any charting library.
tour.languageLesson: A deterministic force layout seeds its random positions from a fixed value, so the same input graph produces the same picture on every load. That keeps screenshots and visual regression checks stable.

tour.title: French and German Locales
tour.description: Every major page has hand-translated *.fr.html and *.de.html siblings, such as index.fr.html and index.de.html for the home page from Step 2. To stop the translations quietly falling behind, check-i18n-drift.py hashes each English page (ignoring generated regions and ?v= tokens) and compares it with the hash recorded in data/i18n-state.json when the translation was last refreshed. The i18n-drift.yml gate runs it on every pull request that touches HTML.

tour.title: Deployment to GitHub Pages
tour.description: pages-deploy.yml is the only build step, and it runs on every push to main and every six hours. It renders Open Graph cards, generates a profile page per member with build-profile-pages.py, writes fallback event and news cards, builds the Pagefind search index and then calls inject-seo.py. That script inserts canonical links, Open Graph tags and JSON-LD between sentinel comments, and stamps every local CSS and JS reference with a ?v= cache-bust token at deploy time, so the tokens are never committed and parallel pull requests do not conflict over them.
tour.languageLesson: Cache busting appends a version query (site.css?v=abc123) derived from the file's content hash. Browsers treat the new URL as a new resource, so a changed stylesheet is fetched immediately while unchanged files stay cached.

tour.title: Guarding the Synced Data
tour.description: Because Steps 5 to 7 open pull requests automatically, the site needs checks that catch a bad sync before it reaches visitors. check-data-shape.py validates the structural invariants each browser renderer depends on, and data-shape-check.yml also smoke-renders the consuming pages in headless Chrome. When a scheduled sync or deploy fails outright, failure-alarm.yml opens or updates a GitHub alarm issue so the maintainer hears about it.

tour.title: The Test Suite
tour.description: Most scripts in scripts/ have a test-*.py companion, and python-tests.yml runs them with pytest on every change to the scripts. test-sync-bios.py covers the bios pipeline from Step 5, test-check-i18n-drift.py covers the drift hashing from Step 10, and test-inject-seo.py covers the deploy step from Step 11. Browser behaviour is tested separately: test-directory-interactions.mjs drives the Directory from Step 4 in headless Chrome with Puppeteer and asserts that the filters respond correctly.
tour.languageLesson: pytest's tmp_path and monkeypatch fixtures let a test build a throwaway copy of the repository and redirect a script's paths into it, so a checker can be exercised end to end without touching real files.

tour.title: Architecture and Releases
tour.description: docs/architecture.md is the maintainer reference that ties the tour together, with data-flow diagrams for the bios, cost.eu, contact form and Indico pipelines seen in Steps 5 to 7. Releases are cut with release.sh, which checks the [Unreleased] section of CHANGELOG.md, promotes it to a dated version and publishes the GitHub Release. CLAUDE.md records the standing working rules, including the branch-and-squash workflow, manual translation only and the prose voice for public copy.
